frozen_params.f_convention: f = disclosed bits / (H * N); 64-bit Toeplitz tag EXCLUDED from f (convention carried from predecessors for comparability); A3 tag-inclusive leakage also reported via key_dependent_bits
frozen_params.single_factor: k1 SHARE of a fixed total at N=32768: totals [7939, 9771] (f_book targets 1.30/1.60) x k1 shares (319/6811, 0.09, 0.14, 0.20); k2 = total - k1; d1 = worst_k(H1,k1) and d2 = worst_k(H2,k2) per point from the same frozen family rule; 8 points
frozen_params.a2_split_rule: not_run (no A2 design/measurement in this probe; A2 summaries not_run)
frozen_params.a3_split_rule: FROZEN grid: labels ['T7939_k1_372_k2_7567', 'T7939_k1_715_k2_7224', 'T7939_k1_1111_k2_6828', 'T7939_k1_1588_k2_6351', 'T9771_k1_458_k2_9313', 'T9771_k1_879_k2_8892', 'T9771_k1_1368_k2_8403', 'T9771_k1_1954_k2_7817']; disclosed = 5*(k1+k2) = 39695 bits (T7939) or 48855 bits (T9771) (f_book bookkeeping only, NOT efficiency points; tag excluded); d1=worst_k(H1,k1) per point; d2=worst_k(H2,k2) per point; one new N=32768 H1/H2 design (design_seed=2026092800, DESIGN_MC=64)
frozen_params.pairing: per (seed, block): rng=default_rng([seed, block]); draw x=integers(0,1024,N=32768) then delta=choice(1024,N,p=pmf); y=(x+delta)%1024; identical (x,y) reused across all 8 grid points via the same (seed,block) index
frozen_params.a3_semantics: run_two_layer_block operational arm FER = (label_match == False); outcomes exact/verify_failed/decode_failed/undetected/resource_abort counted isolated, undetected never merged into success; oracle arm + candidate divergence report-only; toeplitz_master=2026091361

budget.check: every block and every 32 design samples; breach -> immediate stop, status incomplete, no tuning

frozen_params.rerun_policy: one-shot reruns=0; only an implementation-defect death before any measurement may be relaunched once after a fix (error record kept as results.execution_error_attempt1.json); no parameter/seed change
frozen_params.design_mc_choice: DESIGN_MC=64 (not 128) fixed before prereg freeze from the non-result timing smoke (~14.2 s/design sample, ~21.9 s/block at N=32768): 128 samples + 128 blocks ~= 4630 s (86 percent of 5400 s) judged too tight; 64 + 128 ~= 3720 s
deviations_from_plan_A_rows: N=32768 (plan A2/A3 row N=2^15) - matches the real-data block length
128 blocks total (8 points x 2 seeds x 8; plan completion: >=1000 blocks) - Tier-X downscale one-shot
